templateProposal.coverage: Every one of the 54 children resolves to Sheet + Header + Body with at most Sub-header, Footer and back-button toggles; the two footer heights (60 and 76) and three body paddings collapse to one value each. What the template does not carry: the Flowsheets column header row, the PsychotherapyNote toolbar, the Patient Summary feedback row, and the hidden navigation scaffold, all of which are body content or dead layers.
